company: Pengana Investment Management Limited (Responsible Entity for Pengana Private Equity Trust, ASX: PE1)
title: Securities Trading Policy

tiers.name: Pengana Directors
tiers.description: A member of the board of PIML or any of its subsidiaries. Trades must be approved by the PIML Chair and PIML Company Secretary jointly (or their alternates), and a copy of the broker's trade confirmation must be given to the Company Secretary immediately after execution for ASX notification.

tiers.name: Pengana Employees
tiers.description: Employees of Pengana or any of its subsidiaries and all other staff including agency workers, interns, secondees and contractors/consultants, including Key Management Personnel. Trades are notified and approved through the Pengana Operations Team via the Internal Compliance portal.

tiers.name: Connected Persons
tiers.description: A spouse, partner, child or dependant under 18 of a Pengana Associate, or any other person the Pengana Associate may be expected to control or significantly influence, including other immediate family, business partners, companies or trusts. Must seek clearance through their associated Pengana Associate before trading.

definitions.hedging_definition: hedging or other financial arrangements (including derivative transactions) which operate to limit the economic risk or exposure associated with holding LIT Securities

windows.start_anchor: 5 business days prior to the scheduled release date of the LIT's half year or full year results to the ASX
windows.end_anchor: commencement of trading on the first trading day after such release

windows.start_anchor: 5 business days prior to the LIT announcing a distribution or other capital management initiative that may have a material impact on the price of the LIT's ordinary units
windows.end_anchor: commencement of trading on the first trading day after such announcement

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: The Board may in its absolute discretion determine any other period to be a trading blackout, for all or particular Pengana Associates, at any time, to manage a potential insider trading risk or the appearance of insider trading; the open and close of blackouts is advised by email from the Company Secretary or Pengana Lawyer. The PIML Chair and any other PIML Director, acting jointly under the Power of Veto, may also declare a trading blackout without prior notice. Pengana Associates with knowledge of, and involvement in, a buy-back are separately subject to a blackout from the Responsible Entity's decision to buy back until the day after the buy-back is announced to the ASX.

rules.detail: Absolute ban on derivative transactions that operate to limit the economic risk or exposure of holding LIT Securities, with no venue limitation and no security-state carve-out. Unlike the margin lending/secured financing ban and the short-term trading ban, this clause states no exemption or clearance route.
rules.evidence: Pengana Associates may not enter into hedging or other financial arrangements (including derivative transactions) which operate to limit the economic risk or exposure associated with holding LIT Securities.

rules.detail: Absolute ban on hedging arrangements limiting the economic risk of holding LIT Securities, applying to all Pengana Associates and Connected Persons regardless of vesting status; no exemption route is stated.
rules.evidence: Pengana Associates may not enter into hedging or other financial arrangements (including derivative transactions) which operate to limit the economic risk or exposure associated with holding LIT Securities.

rules.detail: Not named, but a monetisation structure (e.g. prepaid forward) is a financial arrangement that limits the economic risk or exposure of holding LIT Securities and so falls within the hedging ban's broad 'other financial arrangements' language.
rules.evidence: Pengana Associates may not enter into hedging or other financial arrangements (including derivative transactions) which operate to limit the economic risk or exposure associated with holding LIT Securities.

rules.detail: Absolute ban on short selling, defined as borrowing and selling the LIT Security in anticipation of buying back at a lower price; no exemption route stated.
rules.evidence: Pengana Associates are prohibited from trading in LIT Securities where such trading amounts to 'short selling'. This is the practice of attempting to profit from an anticipated drop in the price of LIT Securities by borrowing the LIT Security and selling it in anticipation of later being able to buy the LIT Securities at a lower price to close out their short position at a profit.

rules.detail: Lending out LIT Securities is not addressed; only borrowing securities (as part of the short-selling definition) is mentioned.

Not named, but a CFD referencing LIT Securities used to limit economic exposure to a holding would be an 'other financial arrangement' caught by the hedging ban; a directional (non-hedging) CFD would instead be an ordinary Trade under the general definition, subject to the notification/approval regime.
rules.evidence: Pengana Associates may not enter into hedging or other financial arrangements (including derivative transactions) which operate to limit the economic risk or exposure associated with holding LIT Securities.

rules.detail: Banned unless an exemption is granted under Section 7 (Exceptional Circumstances), a materially higher bar than routine clearance: severe financial hardship, court compulsion, an overriding legal/regulatory requirement, or another circumstance the approver deems exceptional, and only where there is no insider trading risk or appearance of it.
rules.evidence: Pengana Associates may not enter into margin lending or any other secured financing arrangements in respect of its LIT Securities, unless an exemption has been granted in accordance with Section 7 of this policy.

rules.detail: The margin lending/secured financing ban extends to 'any other secured financing arrangements', which on its face covers granting security (a charge or pledge) over LIT Securities for financing purposes generally, subject only to the same narrow Section 7 exemption.
rules.evidence: Pengana Associates may not enter into margin lending or any other secured financing arrangements in respect of its LIT Securities, unless an exemption has been granted in accordance with Section 7 of this policy.

rules.detail: Broadest possible framing ('margin lending or any other secured financing arrangements'), not limited to margin loans, banned unless a Section 7 Exceptional Circumstances exemption is granted.
rules.evidence: Pengana Associates may not enter into margin lending or any other secured financing arrangements in respect of its LIT Securities, unless an exemption has been granted in accordance with Section 7 of this policy.

rules.detail: On-market trading in or out of LIT Securities within 3 months of acquisition is banned unless written prior clearance is approved under Section 7.
rules.evidence: Pengana Associates must not engage in short-term or speculative trading in LIT Securities, i.e. trading in or out of LIT Securities on market within three (3) months of acquiring them, unless written prior clearance to trade has been approved in accordance with Section 7 of this policy.

clearance.approver: Pengana Operations Team (Company Secretary advised of requests before approval)
clearance.evidence: Pengana Employees are required to have their trades approved by the Pengana Operations Team (except for Permitted Trading) and should use the Internal Compliance portal.

clearance.approver: PIML Chair and PIML Company Secretary jointly (Pengana CEO, or failing them any other PIML Director, stands in for the Chair; the Pengana Lawyer stands in for the Company Secretary; where the Chair wants to trade, approval instead comes from the Company Secretary/Pengana Lawyer and the CEO/another Director)
clearance.post_trade_deadline: immediately once the trade has been executed
clearance.evidence: The PIML Chair and the PIML Company Secretary are both required to approve the proposed trades by Pengana Associates (other than Pengana Employees), except for Permitted Trading. ... Approvals to trade will be valid for five business days following the day on which approval was granted.

clearance.approver: Via their associated Pengana Associate, using that Associate's own approval channel
clearance.evidence: a Connected Person must seek clearance through their Pengana Associate in accordance with Section 4 of this policy prior to trading in LIT Securities.

clearance.approver: PIML Chair and PIML Company Secretary (or their Section 4.2 alternates)
clearance.evidence: Exemptions will only be granted in Exceptional Circumstances and only where: there is no legal risk of insider trading and no risk of the appearance of insider trading; trading is not prohibited by virtue of Section 3.1 of this policy; and person requesting the exemption has certified ... that they are not in possession of Inside Information regarding the relevant LIT.

carve_outs: written prior clearance approved under Section 7
short_term.evidence: Pengana Associates must not engage in short-term or speculative trading in LIT Securities, i.e. trading in or out of LIT Securities on market within three (3) months of acquiring them, unless written prior clearance to trade has been approved in accordance with Section 7 of this policy.

exceptions.evidence: participation in any incentive plan operated by the Responsible Entity pursuant to which a Pengana Associate may obtain an interest in LIT Securities, including: accepting an offer under the incentive plan and the subsequent grant of units, options or performance rights ...; and vesting of any units, options or performance rights under the incentive plan
acquisition of LIT Securities through a distribution reinvestment plan or security purchase plan made available to all or most holders
acquisition of LIT Securities through a unit purchase plan available to all retail unitholders; acquisition of LIT Securities through a pro-rata rights issue
the disposal of LIT Securities through the acceptance of a takeover offer, scheme of arrangement, equal access buy-back or capital reduction

dealings that result in no effective change to the beneficial interest in the securities (for example, transfers of LIT Securities already held into a superannuation fund or trust of which the person is a beneficiary)

exceptions.approver: PIML Chair and PIML Company Secretary (or alternates)
exceptions.evidence: cases of severe financial hardship (e.g. if the person has a pressing financial commitment that cannot be satisfied in any other way than by selling LIT Securities)

exceptions.approver: PIML Chair and PIML Company Secretary (or alternates)
exceptions.evidence: compulsion by court order or court enforceable undertaking (e.g. a bona fide family settlement)

exceptions.approver: PIML Chair and PIML Company Secretary (or alternates)
exceptions.evidence: an overriding legal or regulatory requirement to transfer, or accept a transfer of, LIT Securities

exemption_authority: PIML Chair and PIML Company Secretary (or their Section 4.2 alternates: Pengana CEO/another PIML Director for the Chair; the Pengana Lawyer for the Company Secretary) may grant an exemption under Section 7 only in Exceptional Circumstances (severe financial hardship, court order, overriding legal/regulatory requirement, or another circumstance they deem exceptional), and only where there is no insider trading risk or appearance of it. This route is expressly available to bypass the margin lending/secured financing ban and the short-term trading ban, but the standalone hedging/derivatives ban states no exemption mechanism at all.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Pengana Associates may not enter into hedging or other financial arrangements (including derivative transactions) which operate to limit the economic risk or exposure associated with holding LIT Securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Unlike the margin lending and short-term trading bans, this clause never references a Section 7 exemption, so the collar's put and call legs appear to be absolutely prohibited with no clearance pathway at all, regardless of vesting status or blackout timing.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Pengana Associates may not enter into margin lending or any other secured financing arrangements in respect of its LIT Securities, unless an exemption has been granted in accordance with Section 7 of this policy.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Even the loan leg secured on the collared units can only proceed via an Exceptional Circumstances exemption (hardship, court order, or an equivalent event), which is a materially higher and more discretionary bar than the routine trade-approval process used for ordinary dealing.

bespoke_clauses.clause: These prohibitions apply at all times including to Permitted Trading, outside trading blackout periods and even where a trading approval or exemption has been given or granted under this policy. It overrides all other provisions of this policy.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Even if a Section 7 exemption were obtained for the loan, the trade cannot proceed if the executive holds Inside Information at execution, so timing certainty for the bank cannot rely on the exemption alone.

bespoke_clauses.clause: The Pengana Associate is not entitled to receive any reasons for why the trade is denied. If approval is denied, the decision is final and binding ... and the Pengana Associate must keep that information confidential and not disclose it to anyone.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A refused exemption request for the loan or an approval request for the collar's ancillary trades cannot be explained to the bank, and the executive is contractually bound not to disclose even the fact of refusal.

bespoke_clauses.clause: The power of veto is reserved to the PIML Chair and any other PIML Director. Acting jointly, the PIML Chair and any other PIML Director can: overturn any approval to a Pengana Associate to trade; or declare a trading blackout period without prior notice.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Any clearance already obtained for a permitted leg of the structure (or an exemption for the loan) can be overturned at any time without notice, so execution and settlement timelines with the bank carry residual veto risk until completed.

bespoke_clauses.clause: They must not structure arrangements or procure third parties to trade to circumvent the operation of this policy.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Structuring the collar or loan through an intermediary, trust or related entity to avoid the hedging or secured-financing bans would itself be a breach; the Personal Capacity definition also treats trades made in another person's or entity's name as the individual's own.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Approvals to trade will be valid for five business days following the day on which approval was granted. ... approval is granted within five business days of a trading blackout coming into effect, in which case the approval will expire once the trading blackout comes into effect.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Any ordinary dealing approval obtained around the collar (e.g. for a non-hedging incidental trade) lapses in 5 business days and can be cut short by an incoming blackout, requiring tight coordination of execution dates.

summary: A funded collar is not achievable under this policy in its ordinary course. The put and call legs are OTC derivative transactions that operate to limit the economic risk of holding LIT Securities, squarely matching the absolute hedging ban in Section 5, which unlike the other prohibitions in that section states no exemption or clearance mechanism whatsoever. The loan leg fares only marginally better: margin lending and 'any other secured financing arrangements' over LIT Securities are also banned by the same section, but here an exemption can be sought under Section 7's Exceptional Circumstances process (severe financial hardship, court compulsion, or an equivalent event, approved by the PIML Chair and Company Secretary), which is a discretionary, high-bar mechanism rather than routine banking approval and still yields to the overriding insider trading prohibition at execution. Refusals are unreasoned and must be kept confidential, and any clearance obtained can be overturned at any time under the Power of Veto. Absent a bespoke amendment or waiver of this policy by Pengana, neither the hedge nor the secured loan can be structured through ordinary channels, and anti-avoidance and substance-over-form provisions foreclose routing the arrangement through a trust or related entity to escape the bans.
